name: zvid_texture_pack_shutdown
description: zVid_TexturePack::Shutdown closes dynamic texture-pack files, frees each records array, frees the dynamic pack table, and clears the global table/count.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target covers 0x46d780 yet, so tier S remains open.

The native smoke reaches zVid_TexturePack::Shutdown through zImage::ShutdownSubsystem and zVid_TexDir::Shutdown; direct helper coverage is accepted from Binary Ninja evidence plus the caller smoke's dynamic pack state assertions.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x46d780 walks g_zVid_TexturePacks with a 0xa4 byte stride, closes each non-null fileHandle at offset 0x80 with fclose, clears that slot, frees each non-null records pointer at offset 0x9c, clears that slot, frees the global dynamic pack table, clears g_zVid_TexturePacks, and clears g_zVid_TexturePackCount.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x46d780 has no warnings or tags and shows the same dynamic pack file close, records free, global table free, pointer clear, and count clear; the pointer arithmetic is the documented BN limitation from the current function comment.
The dependency frontier for 0x46d780 has no visible functional-verification blockers after accepting the CRT fclose/free providers.

The native zimage_shutdown_texdir_smoke allocates one dynamic texture pack with records and an open file, reaches this helper through ShutdownSubsystem, and verifies g_zVid_TexturePackCount is zero and g_zVid_TexturePacks is null after shutdown.
